_why: night-disc item 1 (the researcher's drawing): every run box is three columns - left the glyph, its kind tag and the coverage cells with 'n of m ch' in body text; middle the name, its facts and the extra actions; right the x, the A/B box and the Report ICON (aria-label and title 'Report'). Measured at a 1024 px window (the page narrowed to 960 px; restored by the next state): no part of any box overlaps another or leaves the box (runs-list data-night-geometry ok; the detail in data-night-geometry-detail)

actions.eval: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('[data-testid="discovery-runs-page"]'); if (p) { p.style.width = '960px'; p.style.maxWidth = '960px'; p.dataset.narrow = '1024px' } })()
